  1. I am against human cloning. That is because it could cause duplication of dictators.
    我反對複製人。那是因為這可能會複製出獨裁者。
  2. Most of my classmates were against the idea.
    我大部分的同學都反對這個想法。
  3. My mother is against keeping a dog in the apartment.
    我媽媽反對在公寓裡養狗。
  4. Are you for or against school uniforms?
    你贊成還是反對學校制服？
  5. My father is for the new train line.
    我爸爸贊成蓋新的鐵路線。
  6. I don't eat breakfast. That is because I get up late.

  7. The roads were icy. That is why the bus was late.
    路面結冰了。所以公車遲到了。
  8. Ken is always tired. That is because he plays games until two.
    Ken 總是很累。那是因為他打電動打到兩點。
  9. My sister loves animals. That is why she wants to be a vet.
    我姊姊很愛動物。所以她想當獸醫。
  10. The store is always crowded. That is because the prices are low.
    那家店總是人很多。那是因為價格很低。
  11. Don't leave your bike here. Someone could take it.
    不要把腳踏車放在這裡。可能會有人把它牽走。
  12. Close the window. The rain could come in.
    把窗戶關上。雨可能會打進來。
  13. I was late for school. That is because I missed the bus.
    我上學遲到了。那是因為我錯過了公車。
  14. I missed the bus. That is why I was late for school.
    我錯過了公車。所以我上學遲到了。
  15. Tom didn't come to the party. That is because he had a fever.
    Tom 沒有來派對。那是因為他發燒了。
  16. Kyoto has many old temples. That is why a lot of tourists visit it.
    京都有很多古老的寺廟。所以很多觀光客去那裡。
  17. The streets are clean in Japan. That is because people take their trash home.
    日本的街道很乾淨。那是因為人們把垃圾帶回家。
  18. I love this café. That is because the coffee is cheap and good.
    我很喜歡這家咖啡店。那是因為這裡的咖啡又便宜又好喝。
  19. She practiced every day. That is why she won the speech contest.
    她每天練習。所以她贏了演講比賽。
  20. It could rain this afternoon.
    今天下午有可能會下雨。
  21. Be careful. That knife could cut you.
    小心。那把刀可能會割傷你。
  22. Don't run on the stairs. You could fall.
    不要在樓梯上跑。你可能會跌倒。
  23. This medicine could make you sleepy.
    這個藥可能會讓你想睡。
  24. The typhoon could hit Taiwan this weekend.
    颱風這個週末可能會侵襲台灣。
  25. I am against the new rule. That is because it could make students study less.
    我反對新規定。那是因為它可能讓學生讀書讀得更少。
  26. My teacher is against using phones in class. That is because students could stop listening to her.
    我的老師反對上課用手機。那是因為學生可能會不聽她講課。
  27. Many people are against the new road. That is because it could destroy the forest.
    很多人反對那條新道路。那是因為它可能會破壞森林。
  28. We are against building a big hotel near the beach. That is why we signed the letter.
    我們反對在海邊附近蓋大飯店。所以我們在那封信上簽了名。
  29. If you eat too much sugar, you could get sick.
    你吃太多糖的話可能會生病。
  30. Be careful with that box. It could be heavy.
    那個箱子小心點。它可能很重。
  31. I went to bed early last night. That is because I had a test this morning.
    我昨晚很早睡。那是因為我今天早上有考試。
  32. I didn't study at all. That is why I failed the test.
    我完全沒讀書。所以我考試沒過。
  33. Watch out! The ice could break.
    小心！冰可能會裂開。
  34. I didn't call you last night. That is because my phone was broken.
    我昨晚沒打給你。那是因為我的手機壞了。
  35. Are you for or against homework on weekends?
    你贊成還是反對週末出作業？
